CustomField.description: Level at which calls to ExpSystem.debug will be logged. 1 for Finest, 2 for Finer, 3 for Fine, 4 for Debug, 5 for Info, 6 for Warn, 7 for Error. A number greater than 7 means no extended logging.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Level at which calls to ExpSystem.debug will be logged. 1 for Finest, 2 for Finer, 3 for Fine, 4 for Debug, 5 for Info, 6 for Warn, 7 for Error. A number greater than 7 means no extended logging.
CustomField.label: Logging Level
